context: The Binance incident now has an official company funding update, a secondary Ethereum-only PoR crosswalk, provider-divergent XRP derivatives aggregates, point-in-time spot depth, non-final ETF holdings data and a direct Ripple-Coinbase RLUSD distribution announcement. These sources measure different assets, universes and states.
decisions: Keep Binance corporate funding commitments, token-by-token reserves, frozen assets, recovered assets and customer liabilities as separate fields; do not infer an XRP reserve ratio from aggregate USD statements.

Treat CoinDesk's Binance 14/16 proof-of-reserves analysis as Ethereum-only. The five XRPL source-wallet membership question can be resolved only by an official XRP address export plus raw validated XRPL balances and corresponding customer liabilities.

Record Binance's market/OTC acquisition statement as a potential capital-flow channel, not executed XRP demand. Require token-level quantity, trade/OTC execution evidence and timing before admitting any XRP replenishment feature.

Store OI, funding, liquidations, long/short ratios and spot depth by provider, venue, contract, pair, timestamp and coverage universe. Do not average CoinGecko's broad 134-market aggregate with TradRadar's seven-exchange subset.

Use issuer-reported ETF holdings and settled daily rows. Keep provisional rows out of model training; separate spot funds, derivative products, index-fund sleeves, reconstructed rows and withheld fund flows.

Treat Ripple-Coinbase RLUSD trading/management and network support as a direct stablecoin distribution relationship. Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral remains future availability until verified live. No XRP collateral or price-demand feature is inferred.
Keep dynamic spot prices and order-book depth context-only until exact point-in-time timestamps, source methodology, quote currency, venue and data freshness are captured.

No XRP market feature is admitted from this snapshot. Forecast remains NOT_ISSUED until immutable fixed-horizon outcomes, leakage-safe point-in-time features, baseline comparison, walk-forward evaluation and probability calibration are executed and verified.
invariants: Binance 14 Ethereum PoR membership does not establish membership of any XRPL source wallet.
Frozen assets are not recovered assets; company funds set aside are not token-level proof-of-reserves.
RLUSD, USDC, USDT, XRP and ETH are distinct assets; stablecoin activity does not automatically create XRP demand.
Spot depth, derivatives OI and funding are provider/venue scoped and cannot be merged without identical universe and timestamp.
ETF holdings-derived flows are not equivalent to independently verified net external capital.
DESIGNED, EXECUTED and VERIFIED remain separate states.
No forecast or real-money trade is authorized by this research snapshot.
